# ICP Intelligence MCP connector

> ICP Intelligence gives Claude nine tools for defining and using an ideal customer profile: a deep dive on your best customers, a scoring model, buyer group mapping, a TAM, SAM and SOM calculation, lookalike targeting criteria, account prioritization, gap analysis, ICP change tracking and interview synthesis. Every tool works only from the data you give it; it does not look anything up.

- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Setup and tools: https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/
- Privacy policy: https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/privacy.html
- Local npm package: @shashwatgtmalpha/icp-intelligence-mcp
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/icp-intelligence-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)

## Tools

- ICP Deep Dive (icp_deep_dive): Analyze customer data to detect ICP patterns - firmographics, technographics, buying behavior
- ICP Scoring Model (icp_scoring_model): Create qualification scoring model with auto-weighted criteria based on your success patterns
- Buyer Group Analyzer (buyer_group_analyzer): Map buyer group dynamics, influence relationships, and decision-making process
- TAM SAM SOM Calculator (tam_sam_som_calculator): Calculate TAM/SAM/SOM using bottom-up methodology from your data (calculation framework, not data source)
- Lookalike Signal Generator (lookalike_signal_generator): Generate platform-specific targeting criteria and search queries (generates criteria, not data)
- Account Prioritization (account_prioritization): Rank and prioritize accounts using multi-dimensional scoring
- ICP Gap Analysis (icp_gap_analysis): Analyze gaps between current customer base and ideal ICP
- ICP Evolution Tracker (icp_evolution_tracker): Track how your ICP should evolve based on market changes and data
- ICP Interview Synthesizer (icp_interview_synthesizer): Extract ICP patterns from customer interview notes or transcripts

## Questions and answers

### What is ICP Intelligence?

ICP Intelligence gives Claude nine tools for defining and using an ideal customer profile: a deep dive on your best customers, a scoring model, buyer group mapping, a TAM, SAM and SOM calculation, lookalike targeting criteria, account prioritization, gap analysis, ICP change tracking and interview synthesis. Every tool works only from the data you give it; it does not look anything up.

### How do I connect ICP Intelligence to Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, then Add custom connector. Name it ICP Intelligence, paste the server URL https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp, choose no sign-in and select Add. In Claude Code run: claude mcp add --transport http icp-intelligence https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp

### Does ICP Intelligence need an account, and what does it cost?

No account or sign-in is needed, and there is no charge. The server is public and every tool is read-only.

### Which tools does ICP Intelligence include?

9 tools: ICP Deep Dive, ICP Scoring Model, Buyer Group Analyzer, TAM SAM SOM Calculator, Lookalike Signal Generator, Account Prioritization, ICP Gap Analysis, ICP Evolution Tracker, ICP Interview Synthesizer.

### What data does ICP Intelligence keep?

None. Each call is answered from the inputs you give it, and the server stores and logs nothing. Netlify, the host, keeps its own request logs. See the privacy policy.

### Can I run ICP Intelligence on my own computer?

Yes. Run npx -y @shashwatgtmalpha/icp-intelligence-mcp to use the same tools locally over stdio; nothing is sent to us.

### Who built ICP Intelligence?

Shashwat Ghosh, founder of Helix GTM Consulting, a GTM Alpha consultant, AI GTM expert and fractional CMO with 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience.
